# rustinion_group_custom_metrics (Resource)

Manages a group's custom-metrics collection by the Rustinion agent: a DogStatsD/StatsD listener (any Datadog or StatsD client library) and Prometheus/OpenMetrics scrape targets, stored as custom metrics (alert rules `custom:<name>`, dashboards, SLOs). Samples are only stored while the group's basic monitoring is on (`monitoring_enabled`, read-only here). A device can override the on/off switch (device page or `PUT /api/v1/customer/devices/{id}/custom-metrics`), and the device's own policy.toml `[custom_metrics] enabled = false` wins over both. Destroying this resource switches collection off and restores the defaults.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Collect custom metrics on the group's devices. Default false.
- `flush_interval_secs` (Number) How often aggregated StatsD values are sent (10-3600). Counters are the total per interval, gauges the last value. Default 60.
- `scrape_targets` (Attributes List) Prometheus/OpenMetrics endpoints each device scrapes (at most 20). Counters are stored as the increase since the previous scrape; histogram buckets are skipped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scrape_targets))
- `statsd_address` (String) UDP `ip:port` the listener binds. `127.0.0.1:8125` (default) accepts local applications only; `0.0.0.0:8125` also accepts containers and other hosts.
- `statsd_enabled` (Boolean) Run the StatsD/DogStatsD listener. Default true.
- `statsd_socket` (String) Optional Unix datagram socket path (like DogStatsD's DD_DOGSTATSD_SOCKET), e.g. `/var/run/rustinion/dsd.socket`. Linux/macOS/BSD.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
- `monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the group's basic monitoring is on (read-only). Nothing is stored while it is off.

<a id="nestedatt--scrape_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scrape_targets`

Required:

- `metrics` (List of String) Metric names or patterns to keep (`*` and `?` wildcards), matched against the exposition's family or sample name, e.g. `node_load*`.
- `url` (String) http:// or https:// URL, fetched by each device (`http://localhost:9100/metrics` = the node exporter on the device).

Optional:

- `interval_secs` (Number) Scrape interval, 10-3600 seconds. Default 60.
- `max_series` (Number) Series kept per scrape (1-2000); the rest are counted as skipped on the device page. Default 200.
- `namespace` (String) Prefix for the stored names (`<namespace>_<name>`): lowercase letters, digits, underscore, up to 30.
- `tags` (Map of String) Fixed tags added to every series of this target (label tags win), at most 8.
